en: The image shows a black-and-white photograph of a formal outdoor ceremony. The foreground is dominated by men in elaborate ceremonial attire, including bishops wearing mitres and holding crosiers, and other dignitaries in uniforms with sashes and medals. The background shows a crowd of onlookers, some in hats and period clothing, as well as a horse-drawn carriage. The overall style of dress and the photographic technique suggest an early 20th-century European setting.
